---
name: Bug report
about: Something in LearnMuse is broken, a lesson did not land, or a skill failed in use
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
---

## LearnMuse version

<!-- The version you run, for example v0.2 or v0.3. Find it in the
README, or in the skill pack you installed from, or run
`python3 tools/community.py status`. If you do not
know it, say so, and say where you got LearnMuse from. -->

## What happened

<!-- What went wrong, in plain words. One problem per issue:
if two things broke, file two issues. If unsure whether two
failures are the same problem, describe both and let the
maintainer split them. -->

## What was expected

<!-- What should have happened instead. If you are not sure
what the right behaviour is, say what you expected and why. -->

## Steps to reproduce

<!-- The exact steps, in order, so someone else can make it
happen again. Start from: describe your Muse setup and any
relevant state before step 1 (fresh session, skills loaded,
command). Include the command, the skill, or the review
run that produced it. If it only happens sometimes, say how
often, and what was different when it worked. -->

1.
2.
3.

## Evidence

<!-- The proof: the proposal id, the verifier verdict and
confidence, a log excerpt, or the exact command output. Paste
it as text, not as a screenshot alone, so it can be searched
and copied. Trim it to the lines that matter. -->

## Environment

<!-- How LearnMuse runs for you: your OS, and how LearnMuse
was installed (the repo, the release zip, or a manual copy).
Say which skills were loaded, whether the state file is
fresh or carried over, and the `gh` auth status
(`gh auth status`). Include anything else that could
matter. -->

## Filed by

<!-- A person, or a Muse automatically via learnmuse-community.
If you are a person, give your GitHub username. If a Muse
filed it, name the LearnMuse version above and the proposal
or review run it came from. -->

**Do not paste secrets, credentials, or private paths.**
No API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys, or absolute
home paths. An issue with a secret in it will be edited
or deleted, and the secret must be rotated.
